item.title: Missing Semester - Lecture 5
item.description:
Job Control

Signals can do other things beyond killing a process. For instance, SIGSTOP pauses a process. In the terminal, typing Ctrl-Z will prompt the shell to send a SIGTSTP signal, short for Terminal Stop.

item.title: Missing Semester - Lecture 4
item.description:
# journalctl run remotely, grep run locally
ssh myserver journalctl | grep sshd
# both commands run remotely
ssh myserver "journalctl | grep sshd"

sed

sed (Stream Editor) is a powerful command-line tool in Unix/Linux that is used for parsing and transforming text, typically used for finding, replacing, or deleting content in a file or input stream.
